item.title: 🚀 New Model: grok-4.7 · xAI
item.description: 🏢 xAI 🧠 grok-4.7 📝 Grok 4.7, SpaceXAI's frontier model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, is now available on the xAI API as grok 4.7 . It has a 500k context window, text and image inputs with text only output, and no text output limit.
